A new fact or preference does not need to concern the same topic as an existing fact. Preserve a preference as a preference and a requirement as a requirement, not as a completed action. A user may report a prior project state or what a named source said. Such a report can support a memory of that history or report even when it is not a current requirement. Fiction, questions, hypotheticals, and assistant suggestions still do not establish user preferences or adopted project decisions. Do not invent facts or IDs. Return JSON only: {"decision":"facts","facts":[{"content":"...","evidence_ids":["source-id"],"operation":"add"}]}.
